name: Sucro Limited
summary: Sucro Limited, headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida, and established in 2014, functions as a prominent wholesale sugar distributor throughout North America. The company's activities are organized into two primary divisions: Trade and Services. The Trade segment focuses on the procurement, marketing, and logistical coordination of sugar products. The Services segment supports its Trade counterpart by delivering crucial functions such as tolling (encompassing sugar refining, processing, handling, packaging, and quality assurance), storage facilities, administrative assistance, real estate management, and brokerage services. Moreover, Sucro Limited is involved in sugar processing operations. The company primarily caters to wholesale businesses and manufacturers within the food and beverage sector. Sucro Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of SC Americas Corp.
